one_next_native_read.scope: Account 477439, campaign 402056810, September 6, 2023–September 6, 2026; summary by reported keyword and goal, prioritizing the candidate keyword names already evidenced.
one_next_native_read.interpretation: Read goal-specific counts and values separately. Keep each unsegmented keyword spend/click denominator once; never sum repeated goal-row costs or treat blank goal cost as zero.
one_next_native_read.practical_limit: The native Keyword template and Modify path are documented; Goal/GoalId/GoalType and CurrencyCode coexist in the official KeywordPerformanceReportColumn schema. Their simultaneous availability in this exact native picker is unverified; inspect it once and report a precise missing-field limitation if absent. Do not assume API schema proves this UI combination.
one_next_native_read.currency_limit: CurrencyCode denotes account currency. Native Attributes search returning no Currency field does not settle all reports. The ConversionPerformanceReportColumn schema lacks CurrencyCode, so it alone is not a documented single-report answer to both questions.
one_next_native_read.no_save_or_bypass: Use ordinary permitted read/preview controls; no report schedule, account change, campaign mutation, or workaround for blocked chrome://downloads.

decision_limits: Reported 667 equals campaign value, not 667 of verified retained merchandise revenue; never allocate URL versus event goal counts to queries without the join.
Every positive-value query has only 1–2 clicks; selection on conversions/revenue is biased and cannot establish repeatable CPA, CVR or return.
Do not compare 0.13/0.15 account-unit observations with USD 0.15, claim USD 10.77 CPA viability, or infer the approximately 6.5x profitable-growth objective is met.
Candidate landing/product fit, actual allowable CPA, current matching/status/exposure and exact spend authority remain separate gates. No live test or negative authorized by this report.
Historical attributed traffic does not prove incremental traffic, new customers, lift or profitable sales. Zero rows are only zero as displayed.
